notes: Big operations batch: Telegram alerts now fire on every product change (price, quantity, name, barcode) and every message is translated to Arabic/English/French per UI language and attributed to the acting user (cashier, editor, etc.). New role-based access: Cashier users only see POS, sales history, expenses and customers; Settings is admin-only. Employees get an RFID tag field, scannable from the POS search bar. Product editor gains a quantity-history tab (old/new/delta/type/user for every sale, purchase, return and manual edit), fully translated pricing labels and Enter-to-next-field flow. POS cart total gets an eye button revealing the cart cost and margin; purchase mode and purchase invoices show the estimated sale value. Scrolling no longer changes number inputs, the register description clears after closing, Settings tabs open instantly, and factory reset has a 10-second cancel countdown.
